create_get_init_metrics: create initial model metrics including parameter counts for embedding and non-embedding layers
run_get_metrics: run training step metrics computation with loss, gradients, params, and updates
aggregate_microbatch_metrics: aggregate per-microbatch metrics into a single batch-level metric dictionary
create_average_class: create a running mean and standard deviation tracker using Welford's parallel algorithm
test_average_merge: test merging two Average instances to compute combined mean, variance, and standard error
